selection_rule: same deterministic cell as lightweight_pcste_efficiency_v1 (lowest fold, then lowest seed)
method: actual torch.save bytes of a state-dict-only payload; never an estimate
parameter_count_note: Q8 does NOT change the parameter count (1,379,813 for encoder + 4 heads). Only the storage precision of allowlisted Linear weights changes.
separation_rule: the packed torch.ao artifact carries runtime packing/observer overhead and is reported SEPARATELY from the compact int8 state and from the theoretical weight bytes; the three are never mixed into one number
accounting_note: Counts are taken directly from the model. int8 = the weights of the 23 allowlisted Linear modules (1,322,816); fp32 = every remaining parameter (56,997), which includes the biases of those same Linears plus dt_proj, A_log, D, conv1d, all LayerNorms and stem.conv. The historical apply_q8_simulated n_int8_params/n_fp32_params counters are not used for this table: they omit quantized-module biases and include 16 buffer values, so they do not sum to the parameter count. Q8 does not change the parameter count.
